title: SvelteKit build-time import guard can expose server secrets in browser bundles
summary: The server-only import guard can fail when imports pass through src/params.js. Server secrets can then be statically embedded into browser code.

severity.rationale: This build-time boundary failure can disclose server secrets to browser clients. It requires a specific import path, but credential exposure warrants a 72-hour response for affected builds.

exposure: Projects built with affected SvelteKit versions and server-only imports through src/params.js are exposed. Other import paths are not established as affected by this advisory.

remediation.details: Use SvelteKit 3.1.1 or later, then rebuild affected browser bundles with the corrected import guard.
remediation.risk: Updating can interrupt dependent workflows; test compatibility before resuming them.

verification: Confirm the build resolves @sveltejs/kit 3.1.1 or later; verify server-only imports through src/params.js are rejected from browser code.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
